title: Directed Galois partitions and their constructible class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal P=(V_i\to S_i)_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(s)}$ a Galois partition, with weak module-sheaf class $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ [def-per-galois-partition-modules]. For every commutative ring $A$, define its constructible class to be the full class of $A$-module sheaves $F$ with $F\in\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ and $F$ constructible [def-constructible-constructible]. Say that $\mathcal P$ is directed if there exists a permutation $e$ of $\mathrm{Fin}(s)$ such that $X\setminus\bigcup_{i<k}S_{e(i)}$ is closed for every $0\le k\le s$. Equivalently, the strata admit an ordering in which each next stratum is open in the remaining reduced closed complement. The empty partition is included.
